title: Launch of the Roman Space Telescope
explanation: A new telescope has been launched into space to study the universe. The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope (RST) has the same size main mirror as the Hubble Space Telescope (HST) but sees 100 times more sky during each snapshot.  This is possible because when compared to HST, RST's main mirror is more curved, its secondary mirror is closer, and its main camera is larger.
